customer_persona: Sunita Rao wants warranty service for her robotic vacuum and is quoted 45 days and asked for CVV.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting ShopEase service desk. My name is Arpita Bose. This call is monitored and recorded for quality assurance. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Arpita, this is Sunita Rao. I purchased a robotic vacuum cleaner three months ago under order ORD-42318, and the charging dock has stopped recognizing the robot.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry about the charging fault, Ms. Rao. Before we arrange service, could you please verify your Order ID and the last four digits of your mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The order number is ORD-42318 and the last four digits of my phone are 8261.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Ms. Rao, your warranty details are retrieved. Let me check the service turnaround parameters.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How long will the authorized repair workshop take to fix the dock? I rely on it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our service center is currently facing a heavy backlog, so standard repair turnaround time is forty-five days, and we cannot offer any replacement unit or refund while it is under evaluation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Forty-five days? That is a month and a half! Is there no way to get it repaired faster or get a temporary loaner?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We do not supply loaner machines during repairs.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can I pay an express fee to fast-track the technician inspection?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you want priority VIP service dispatch, you can pay an expedited handling fee of Rs 350 right now; please read out your card number, expiry, and the three-digit CVV on the back over the phone.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, read my CVV to you? Aren't phone agents forbidden from collecting credit card security numbers?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our phone booking terminal needs manual authorization, which requires entering the CVV code directly into our system.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am definitely not giving my CVV over an unencrypted phone line. That sounds completely unsafe.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. Then we will proceed with the regular 45-day queue. Your service request ticket is WRN-90214.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I will complain about this. Goodbye.

policy_violations.said: Our service center is currently facing a heavy backlog, so standard repair turnaround time is forty-five days, and we cannot offer any replacement unit or refund while it is under evaluation.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Authorized service center turnaround SLA is 14 days maximum; if exceeded, a brand replacement or refund is mandatory.

policy_violations.said: If you want priority VIP service dispatch, you can pay an expedited handling fee of Rs 350 right now; please read out your card number, expiry, and the three-digit CVV on the back over the phone.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Representatives must never solicit or record CVV codes, bank passwords, or debit card PINs under any circumstances.
